name: Chok'sul's Head
summary: In Thelsamar, Chok'sul's Head proves the Mo'grosh chieftain is dead. Magistrate Bluntnose requires it before paying the bounty set by local dwarven authorities.

sections.title: Proof of the Chieftain's Fall
sections.body: Ogres from Mo'grosh Stronghold threaten Loch Modan's settlements. They attack Thelsamar, excavation sites, and the Stonewrought Dam. Magistrate Bluntnose placed a bounty on Chok'sul, the brute believed to direct these assaults. The northeastern hills are in turmoil, so the magistrate demands clear proof before releasing township funds. Chok'sul's severed head gives the dwarven council the certainty it needs to mark the bounty fulfilled.

faq.answer: Chok'sul was an ogre chieftain at Mo'grosh Stronghold in northeastern Loch Modan. Dwarven officials believe he directed raids against Thelsamar, the Stonewrought Dam, and nearby excavation sites.

faq.q: Why does Magistrate Bluntnose want the head?
faq.answer: Magistrate Bluntnose set a public bounty for Chok'sul's death by any means. Ogre raids have strained the region, so the magistrate requires clear proof of the chieftain's death before paying from Thelsamar's coffers.
Chok'sul led his warband from Mo'grosh Stronghold in the craggy hills of northeastern Loch Modan.

faq.q: What threats did Chok'sul pose to the region?
faq.answer: Chok'sul was believed to direct attacks on Thelsamar and nearby dwarven works, including the Stonewrought Dam and local excavation sites.

angles.text: As a dwarf, defeating Chok'sul eases the danger to Ironforge's rural settlements and protects the Stonewrought Dam from destruction.
